tagline: Agree on a deal, then track what each of you has delivered.

linkPreview.title: Exchange
linkPreview.description: You’ve been invited to review an exchange.

service.unreachable: The service can’t be reached right now.

INVITATION_CLAIMED.subject: The person you invited has joined ({code})
INVITATION_CLAIMED.body: The person you invited has opened your invitation and joined the exchange. They can now review the terms you sent.

INVITATION_CLAIMED_UNCONFIRMED.subject: Confirm who joined your exchange ({code})
INVITATION_CLAIMED_UNCONFIRMED.body: Someone has used your invitation link to join the exchange. Check that it is the person you meant to invite, then confirm them. Nothing can be agreed until you do.

COUNTERPARTY_CONFIRMED.subject: You’ve been confirmed ({code})
COUNTERPARTY_CONFIRMED.body: The other party has confirmed that you are the person they invited. The two of you can now reach an agreement.

REVISION_SENT.subject: New terms to review ({code})
REVISION_SENT.body: The other party has sent new terms. Review them, then accept them, decline them or send your own.

AMENDMENT_PROPOSED.subject: A change to your agreement is proposed ({code})
AMENDMENT_PROPOSED.body: The other party has proposed a change to your agreement. The agreement stays as it is unless you accept the change.

ACCEPTANCE_WAITING.subject: The terms were accepted and are waiting for you ({code})
ACCEPTANCE_WAITING.body: The other party has accepted the terms. Their acceptance takes effect once you confirm that they are the person you meant to invite.

AGREEMENT_IN_FORCE.subject: Your agreement is in force ({code})
AGREEMENT_IN_FORCE.body: Both of you have accepted the same terms, so the agreement is now in force. You can track what each of you delivers.

AMENDMENT_IN_FORCE.subject: The change to your agreement was accepted ({code})
AMENDMENT_IN_FORCE.body: The other party has accepted the change you proposed. It is now part of the agreement.

AMENDMENT_DECLINED.subject: The change you proposed was declined ({code})
AMENDMENT_DECLINED.body: The other party has declined the change you proposed. The agreement stays as it was.

AMENDMENT_WITHDRAWN.subject: A proposed change was withdrawn ({code})
AMENDMENT_WITHDRAWN.body: The other party has withdrawn the change they proposed. The agreement stays as it was.

AMENDMENT_EXPIRED.subject: A proposed change expired ({code})
AMENDMENT_EXPIRED.body: A proposed change to your agreement expired before it was accepted. The agreement stays as it was.

DELIVERY_CLAIMED.subject: Something was marked as delivered ({code})
DELIVERY_CLAIMED.body: The other party has marked one of their contributions as delivered. Review it, then confirm it or dispute it.

CLAIM_RETRACTED.subject: A delivery was unmarked ({code})
CLAIM_RETRACTED.body: The other party has taken back their claim that a contribution was delivered. There is nothing for you to review for now.

DELIVERY_CONFIRMED.subject: A delivery was confirmed ({code})
DELIVERY_CONFIRMED.body: The other party has confirmed that they received one of your contributions.

DISPUTE_OPENED.subject: A delivery was disputed ({code})
DISPUTE_OPENED.body: The other party has disputed a contribution you marked as delivered. Read their reason in the exchange and respond.

CONTRIBUTION_WAIVED.subject: A contribution was waived ({code})
CONTRIBUTION_WAIVED.body: The other party has waived one of your contributions. You are no longer expected to deliver it.

END_PROPOSED.subject: A proposal to end your exchange ({code})
END_PROPOSED.body: The other party has proposed ending the exchange by agreement. If you accept, everything still outstanding is released.

END_PROPOSAL_CANCELLED.subject: The proposal to end your exchange was cancelled ({code})
END_PROPOSAL_CANCELLED.body: The proposal to end the exchange by agreement has been cancelled. The exchange carries on as before.

CLOSE_REQUESTED.subject: The other party has asked to close your exchange ({code})
CLOSE_REQUESTED.body: The other party has asked to close the exchange with matters still unresolved. You have a limited time to respond: you can add a statement, resolve what is outstanding or agree to end it. After that, the exchange closes as unresolved.

CLOSE_REQUEST_RETRACTED.subject: The request to close your exchange was withdrawn ({code})
CLOSE_REQUEST_RETRACTED.body: The other party has withdrawn their request to close the exchange. It stays open.

STATEMENT_ADDED.subject: A statement was added to your exchange ({code})
STATEMENT_ADDED.body: The other party has added a statement about the request to close the exchange. You can read it in the exchange.

INACTIVITY_PROMPTED.subject: Is your exchange still under way? ({code})
INACTIVITY_PROMPTED.body: Nothing has happened in this exchange for some time. If neither of you does anything in it, it will be closed as unresolved.

CLOSED_WITHDRAWN.subject: The offer was withdrawn ({code})
CLOSED_WITHDRAWN.body: The other party has withdrawn their offer, so the exchange is closed. Nothing was agreed.

CLOSED_DECLINED.subject: Your offer was declined ({code})
CLOSED_DECLINED.body: The other party has declined your offer, so the exchange is closed. Nothing was agreed.

CLOSED_EXPIRED.subject: The offer expired ({code})
CLOSED_EXPIRED.body: The offer expired before it was accepted, so the exchange is closed. Nothing was agreed.

CLOSED_COMPLETED.subject: Your exchange is complete ({code})
CLOSED_COMPLETED.body: Every required contribution has been accepted or waived. The exchange is complete and closed.

CLOSED_ENDED_BY_AGREEMENT.subject: Your exchange was ended by agreement ({code})
CLOSED_ENDED_BY_AGREEMENT.body: The other party has agreed to end the exchange. It is closed, and everything still outstanding has been released.

CLOSED_UNRESOLVED.subject: Your exchange was closed unresolved ({code})
CLOSED_UNRESOLVED.body: The time to respond to the request to close has passed. The exchange is closed as unresolved, and each contribution keeps the status it had.

CLOSED_INACTIVE.subject: Your exchange was closed for inactivity ({code})
CLOSED_INACTIVE.body: Nothing happened in this exchange for a long time, so it has been closed as unresolved. Each contribution keeps the status it had.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Enter your email address or phone number and we’ll send you a one-time code. There’s no password.
signIn.identifierHint: For a phone number, start with the country code, such as +1.
signIn.codeHint: The 6-digit code we just sent you.
signIn.resent: A new code is on its way.
signIn.changeIdentifier: Use a different email address or phone number

profile.firstIntro: We need this before you can sign anything.
profile.title: Account
profile.nameHint: Shown to the people you make exchanges with.
profile.adultConfirmed: You have confirmed that you are 18 or over.
profile.adultRequired: You have to be 18 or over to use Exchange.

home.title: Your exchanges
home.empty: You have no exchanges yet. Start one, or open an invitation link someone sent you.
home.tooManyToday: You’ve started as many exchanges as one day allows. Try again tomorrow.

closedReasons.EXPIRED: The proposal expired before both of you had signed it.
closedReasons.CLOSE_REQUEST: One of you asked to close it and the time to respond ran out. Each item keeps the status it had.
closedReasons.INACTIVE: It was closed after a long time with no activity. Each item keeps the status it had.

terms.ownWords: The names, terms and descriptions here are the parties’ own words. Exchange never translates or changes them.
terms.dueOnAgreement: Due when the agreement is signed
terms.timezone: Dates are in the {timezone} time zone.

composer.titleAmend: Propose a change to the agreement
composer.introFirst: Write down what each of you will do. Nothing is sent until you sign it.
composer.introCounter: These are the terms now on the table. Change what you need. Sending yours replaces them.
composer.introAmend: This is the agreement as it stands. Change what you need. It stays as it is until you have both signed the change.
composer.yourName: Your name, as it should appear
composer.termsHint: Anything you both need to agree that isn’t one of the items below.
composer.criteriaLabel: How you’ll both know it’s done (optional)
composer.requiredLabel: The exchange isn’t complete without this
composer.locked: This has been confirmed, so it can’t be changed or removed.
composer.noteHint: Sent with the terms, but not part of what you sign.
composer.saveFailed: Your draft couldn’t be saved. Your changes are still on this page; keep it open and try again.
composer.problemsSummary: {count, plural, one {# thing needs fixing before you can sign.} other {# things need fixing before you can sign.}}

problems.NO_REQUIRED_CONTRIBUTION: At least one item has to be required. Otherwise the exchange would be complete the moment it was agreed.
problems.QUANTITY_INVALID: Enter the quantity as a number, such as {example}, or leave quantity and unit empty.
problems.AMOUNT_INVALID: Enter the amount as a number, such as {example}.
problems.DEPENDENCY_MISSING: Choose which item this waits for.
problems.DEPENDENCY_CYCLE: These items wait for each other, so neither would ever fall due. Choose a different one.

composer.signIntro: These are the terms exactly as they will be sent. Signing sends them to the other party.
composer.conflict: This exchange changed while you were writing. Your unsent changes are kept. Check them against the latest terms before you sign.
composer.staleDraft: You have unsent changes that you started before the terms last changed.
composer.staleDraftDiscard: Start again from the current terms
composer.notAvailable: There is nothing to change on this exchange right now.

consent.heading: Signing electronically
consent.pendingReview: Placeholder wording, pending legal review. Not to be used for a real agreement.
consent.binding: By signing, you agree to these exact terms. Your signature is electronic and is meant to bind you in the same way a handwritten one would.
consent.electronic: You agree to sign electronically, and to receive this agreement and its records electronically.
consent.noJudge: Exchange records what you both agreed and what each of you reports. It does not hold money, decide disputes or guarantee that anyone delivers.
consent.agree: I have read these terms and I sign them.

invitationLink.heading: Invitation link
invitationLink.intro: Send this link to the other party yourself, however you usually reach them. Exchange does not send it for you.
invitationLink.shownOnce: This link is shown only this once. If you lose it you can create a new one, and the old one stops working.
invitationLink.copyFailed: It couldn’t be copied. Select the link and copy it yourself.
invitationLink.shareText: I’ve sent you an exchange to review.
invitationLink.unclaimed: Nobody has opened your invitation link yet.
invitationLink.reissueIntro: Lost the link, or sent it to the wrong person? Create a new one. The old link stops working.
invitationLink.forHint: Their email address or phone number. Only someone who signs in with it can then use the link. Leave it empty and whoever you give the link to can use it; you’ll be asked to confirm who they are.

invitation.title: You’ve been invited to an exchange
invitation.intro: {name} wants to agree this with you. Read it, then sign in to accept it, decline it or propose changes.
invitation.introSignedIn: {name} wants to agree this with you. Read it, then respond to accept it, decline it or propose changes.
invitation.notBinding: Nothing binds you until you sign.
invitation.bound: This invitation is for one particular person. Sign in with the email address or phone number it was sent to.
invitation.missing: The invitation link has lost its last part. Open it again from the message it came in, or ask the sender for a new one.
invitation.ownInvitation: This is your own invitation link. Send it to the other party; you can’t use it yourself.
invitation.alreadyResponded: If you have already responded to it, it is among your exchanges.

safety.heading: Report or block
safety.reportIntro: Tell us what is wrong. We review every report. {name} isn’t told that you reported it.
safety.reportProposalIntro: Tell us what is wrong with this proposal. We review every report. The person who sent it isn’t told that you reported it.

reasons.PROHIBITED_TRADE: Something illegal, or not allowed here
reasons.SCAM: A scam, or an attempt to cheat someone
reasons.IMPERSONATION: Someone pretending to be someone else
reasons.UNWANTED: Spam, or something I never asked for

safety.detailsHint: Only the people who review reports see this.
safety.reportSent: We’ve received your report and will review it.
safety.tooManyReports: That’s as many reports as can be sent in one day. Try again tomorrow.
safety.blockStops: {name} won’t be able to join an exchange you start, and you won’t be able to join one they start.
safety.blockEnds: Any proposal still waiting to be signed between the two of you is withdrawn or declined.
safety.blockKeeps: An agreement you’ve both signed stays in force. Either of you can still complete it or close it.
safety.blockQuiet: {name} isn’t told that you blocked them.
safety.unblocked: You’ve unblocked {name}. The two of you can start exchanges with each other again. Anything that ended when you blocked them stays ended.
safety.blockedIntro: Someone you’ve blocked can’t join an exchange you start, and you can’t join one they start. They aren’t told.

exchange.title: Exchange with {name}
exchange.newer: This exchange has changed since you opened it.
exchange.claimedBody: Someone signed in and opened your invitation: {name}, {identifier}. Is this the person you meant to invite?
exchange.claimedSigned: They have already signed. Their signature takes effect when you confirm.
exchange.confirmCounterparty: Yes, this is who I invited
exchange.notThem: If it isn’t, don’t confirm. Withdraw your proposal and start again.
exchange.waitingConfirmation: {name} has not yet confirmed that you are the person they invited. You can sign now; your signature takes effect once they confirm.
exchange.waitingConfirmationSigned: You have signed. Your signature takes effect once {name} confirms that you are the person they invited.
exchange.expires: Open until {date}. If you haven’t both signed by then, it lapses.
exchange.acceptBlocked: Confirm who the other party is before you sign.
exchange.declineEnds: Declining ends this exchange. It can’t be reopened.
exchange.declineKeeps: Declining leaves the agreement as it is.
exchange.withdrawEnds: Withdrawing ends this exchange. It can’t be reopened.
exchange.withdrawKeeps: Withdrawing leaves the agreement as it is.
exchange.signIntro: You are signing the terms shown above, exactly as written.
exchange.remaining: {count, plural, one {# required item is still to be confirmed.} other {# required items are still to be confirmed.}}

moveText.CLAIM: This tells {name} you have delivered it. Only they can confirm it.
moveText.RECLAIM: Say what you did about the dispute. {name} will be asked to confirm again.
moveText.RETRACT_CLAIM: This puts it back to not delivered yet.
moveText.CONFIRM: Confirming is final. It can’t be undone.
moveText.DISPUTE: Say what is wrong. {name} can put it right and mark it delivered again.
moveText.WAIVE: Waiving releases {name} from providing this. It can’t be undone.

exchange.noteRecord: Kept in the record of this exchange.
exchange.proposeEndText: If {name} agrees, the exchange ends and everything still outstanding is waived.
exchange.endProposedByYou: You proposed ending this exchange. {name} has not answered yet.
exchange.agreeEndText: Agreeing ends the exchange now and waives everything still outstanding. It can’t be undone.
exchange.requestCloseText: For when you can’t resolve things together. {name} gets time to respond. After that the exchange closes as unresolved and each item keeps the status it has. Until then you can take the request back.
exchange.closeRequestedByYou: You asked on {date} to close this exchange. It closes as unresolved when the time to respond runs out, unless you take the request back or the two of you resolve what is outstanding.
exchange.closeRequestedByOther: {name} asked on {date} to close this exchange. It closes as unresolved when the time to respond runs out. You can add a statement, resolve what is outstanding, or propose ending by agreement.
exchange.statementAdded: Your statement was added to the record.

errors.STALE_REVISION: The terms changed while you were looking. Review the latest version.
errors.WRONG_ACTOR: Only the other party can do this.
errors.ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED: This can’t be done right now.
errors.CONTRIBUTION_LOCKED: This item has been accepted and can’t be changed.
errors.REVISION_EXPIRED: This offer has expired. Ask for a new one or send your own.
errors.COUNTERPARTY_NOT_CONFIRMED: Confirm who the other party is before accepting.
errors.INVALID_REVISION: Some of the terms need fixing before this can be sent.
errors.INVALID_REQUEST: Something in that request wasn’t right. Check it and try again.
errors.INVALID_IDENTIFIER: Enter a valid email address, or a phone number with its country code.
errors.INVALID_CODE: That code didn’t work. Check it, or ask for a new one.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a little and try again.
errors.IDENTIFIER_IN_USE: That email address or phone number belongs to another account.
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: This exchange changed while you were looking. Review it and try again.
errors.PROFILE_INCOMPLETE: Add your name and confirm you are 18 or over before signing.
errors.CONSENT_OUTDATED: The signing terms have been updated. Review them before signing.
errors.INVITATION_UNAVAILABLE: This invitation link is no longer valid. Ask the sender for a new one.
errors.INVITATION_NOT_FOR_YOU: This invitation was sent to a different email address or phone number.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: That request couldn’t be completed. Try again.
errors.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.
